Chapter 6654: The Tribulation Is Coming

Chapter 6654: The Tribulation Is Coming

“So many treasures, an immortal indeed.” Supreme Black Ancestor couldn’t help but state while staring at the figure.

This became a contest between two absent immortals - Desolate Ancestor and Zhan Sansheng. The legions were mere tools for their rivalry.

Desolate Ancestor left behind an immortal foundation while Zhan Sansheng left behind a shadow. Just these things alone could obliterate any primal ancestor.

“The children are having fun, it’s our turn now.” Black told Weizhen.

“What’s the hurry? It is not the first day of us being enemies.” Weizhen said calmly.

“Waiting for something?” Black asked.

“Not necessarily.” Weizhen shook his head: “But perhaps time is on your side.”

“Hahaha.” Black laughed and said: “I’m afraid you are mistaken today. The longer you wait, the closer you are to death. Methods and reinforcements are useless, your plan is a mere illusion.”

Weizhen’s expression became serious since he understood his foe after so many battles. He trusted Black’s comment and wondered about the opponent’s ace card.

“Who do you consider your ace card? Your master or the two geezers?” Black continued.

“I don’t know.” Weizhen didn’t answer.

“Why are you here? It’s not to stop the ascension?” He asked.

“You worry too much, Brother.” Weizhen smiled and slowly raised his sword.

However, lightning bolts flashed above Life and Death Heaven and interrupted them. They appeared only for a split second but everyone had an ominous feeling.

They became suffocated since this power exceeded imagination. Powerful cultivators felt the same way.

“The tribulation is coming.” Light God and the others shuddered. The strongest dao heart still felt an instinctive fear like a mouse seeing a cat.

Many gazed above and turned pale. The special azure meant for the lord would become the main target. Nevertheless, some celebrated because this area was far removed from everything else.

If the lord had not cared for others and chosen Three Immortals as the ascension ground, more tribulations would descend.

“I hope she will be okay.” Many prayed for her since they appreciated her choice.

Black had a solemn expression since he recalled Bodhi’s ascension. He had also witnessed Desolate Ancestor’s ascension before.

In his opinion, this tribulation was something else, potentially exceeding Desolate Ancestor’s tribulation. The lord had messed with the natural order several times. Although Death Coffin helped her avoid punishments, the eye had finally seen her.

Thus, she faced two separate tests - her cultivation tribulation and punishments, one for each transgression. This destroyed his confidence.

Just the cultivation tribulation alone should have been fine. After all, she had prepared for a long time now. However, these punishment bolts stacked together were a mystery.

Nevertheless, he couldn’t afford to be distracted since he had to deal with Weizhen.

“Brother, it seems the time has come.” Weizhen held his sword steadily forward, one hand on the scabbard and the other on the hilt.

“And?” Black snorted.

“It is regrettable that I will not be able to see Her Majesty during her final moments. We have nothing but admiration for her selflessness.” He said sincerely.

“You can save these words and tell her after the ascension.” Black laughed heartily.

“I hope so, her ascension would be a great fortune for this world.” He said.
